lines.en: I crawl along the bottom.

lines.zh: 我的身体一抽一抽地前进
lines.en: I jerk forward in pulses.
The world underwater is slow.
I grip the weeds with my legs.
My abdomen pumps in and out.
I push up out of the mud.
I have not grown wings yet.
I travel along the rock crevices.
My body is like a small stick.
I move toward disturbed water.
I crawl over smooth stones.
I turn my body and crawl toward the dark.
I keep under the weeds.
I rise and sink again.
I walk in the shallows.
I paddle with my tail.
Time passes slowly on the riverbed.
I look for a dark spot.
I lie on the silt.

lines.zh: 水流把我往石头那边推
lines.en: The current nudges me toward the stones.
The gills along my sides are moving.
I wait for small insects.
I am half-buried in weed.
My color nearly matches the mud.

lines.zh: 我的鳃在水里一张一合
lines.en: My gills open and close in the water.
I stay perfectly still.
My eyes drift.
The cool bottom is pleasant.
I tuck my legs in.
I am waiting for the day I shed this skin.
You are standing on the bank.
Your shadow falls on the water.
I lift my head out of the silt.
You move slowly in water.
I duck to one side.
You stirred mud over me.
I am not afraid, but careful.
Your foot is larger than my body.
I watch you through the weeds.
I will come out when you go.
I curled my body up.
I burrowed back into the mud.
A bit of my shell broke.
Water thinned my blood.
I cannot cry; water swallows it.
I can only shift slowly.
I roll belly-up in the mud.
I hid under the stone.
I am still alive so far.
You have muddied all the water.
I do not take that into my mouth.
Only small water insects suit me.
Drop it in and see.

lines.zh: 这东西沾不到水，我不吃
lines.en: That thing can't get wet; I won't eat it.
It is floating on the surface.
I eat only in water.
I hide when your hand enters.
Nothing in the water ever smelled like that.
Put it in your pack.
I sink down to the bottom.
You knocked me into the mud.
You knock me over into the silt.
My shell is fairly hard.
The water clouded up at once.
I slid past your foot.
You stepped right on me.
I slipped under a stone.
A splash and it was over.
I slip away when you lift your foot.
I can see nothing in this mud.
I still have to grow a long while.
Not convenient underwater.

lines.zh: 我只想找个安全的石头
lines.en: I only want a safe stone.
Let me grow up on the riverbed first.
I have no wings yet.
Wait until I have emerged.
I'm still just a larva in the water.
I burrowed down into the mud.
Get out of the water first.
I need quiet to grow.
I nudge it with a leg.
It has sunk already.
I cannot push it at all.
It grows heavy in water.
It is wedged under a stone.
Reach down for it.
I watch from beside it.
I would only make it dirtier.
The water is helping you, at least.
Too heavy; my legs can't drag it.
Something moved in the water.
It is a small insect.
I creep toward it along the silt.
This is not aimed at you.

lines.zh: 水底的影子一动，我伏低
lines.en: A shadow shifts on the bottom; I flatten down.
It will sink down soon.
I wait for it to come near.
The water hides me well.
I lie on the silt and wait.
Just this one bite.
I crawl forward along the mud.
It has already swum off.
I changed direction.
There is far too much weed here.
I pass under the stone.
I stop and wait.
My movements are slow.
It is right nearby.
I heard the water move.
I follow that mud trail.
I lunged at it.
My jaws extended.
I caught it in my jaws.
Water splashed up.
I missed the bite.

lines.zh: 这一口只咬破了它的壳
lines.en: This bite only cracks its shell.
I rolled in the mud.
You got splashed.
I retreat under the stone.
That raised not even a splash.
I rise from the bottom.
I was already in this water.

lines.zh: 几个泡从泥洞里冒上来
lines.en: A few bubbles rise from my burrow in the mud.
I grew in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我伏在石缝下，只露尾尖
lines.en: I lie under the rock cleft, only my tail tip showing.
I crawl into the light.
The water here is still.
I have not grown wings yet.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来有一阵了
lines.en: I hatched a while ago.

lines.zh: 要贴近水面才找得到我
lines.en: You'll have to lean over the water to find me.
I keep in the silt.
This shallows is mine.
Fire meets water and my shell heats.
I slide off the stone and crack my shell.

lines.zh: 我已经在水里了，可还是被压住
lines.en: I am already in water, yet pressed down.
The blast threw me off the bottom.

lines.zh: 箭头穿过水，钉住我的背
lines.en: The arrowhead cuts the water and pins my back.
The spell keeps me from rising.
There are no small insects left.
Lightning ran through the water to me.
There is not a drop of water here.
